name: blueprint/audio-analysis
description: Audio metrics as receipts: ffmpeg/librosa scripts compute duration, loudness and tempo, the store keeps one receipt per track, the note summarizes
recipe: compute the metrics (print numbers only - collect is bounded) -> receipt per track -> summarize the library note -> scan by prefix for the catalog
pitfalls: print metrics only - full spectrogram dumps blow the collect cap
a missing tool is a red receipt, not a guessed number
one receipt per track keeps the library diffable
